prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Input image is the edit target: the approved black titanium X on a pale mint rounded-square tile with white surrounding canvas.
Add a beautiful, barely perceptible fragment of a TRANSPARENT PROTECTIVE GLASS SHELL behind the X. Preserve all existing pixels' intended appearance: original black titanium X geometry, metallic finish, position and size, pale mint #EAF6EF matte tile and white outer canvas. No changes to the X or background color.

Art direction: extremely restrained, refined optical glass reflection, NOT a drawn circle or loading ring. The visible fragment is a short, softly curved tapered crescent near the upper-right of the X, following the curved boundary of an implied protective dome. Only about 65 to 85 degrees of the dome's rim is visible, the rest is completely invisible. It is close enough to feel related to the X, with generous breathing room around both.
Form: asymmetric and variable thickness, a tiny pearl-white specular glint at its crest transitioning into a translucent pale jade rim. A whisper of soft refracted mint just inside the rim gives a sense of glass thickness. Both ends dissolve smoothly and organically into the unchanged pale mint background, without visible cut ends. One edge briefly sharp and luminous, then softly out of focus. A shallow curved sliver of light, not a uniform stroked line. It should feel like one brief reflection caught on an otherwise invisible protective shell. No substantial filled bubble, disc or color patch.
Composition: the dominant black X remains clear; the shell is behind it, slightly to the upper-right, contained well within the mint tile. The reflection must be much less prominent than the X, around one-tenth of its visual weight. Preserve the open quiet space around the icon.
Avoid: full circles, half circles, progress indicators, orbit rings, equal-width circular strokes, long continuous green lines, swooshes crossing the X, neon, blue, sparkles, stars, flares, extra marks, dramatic shadows, a visible boundary around the entire field, darkening or recoloring the mint tile. Single icon, no text, unchanged framing.
notes: 保留黑钛与浅绿底，光弧需要进一步贴近 X 并弱化亮点。
rejection_reason: 用户取消保护圈，恢复浅绿纯色底与黑钛 X。
